metadata.name: Create Drum Tool
metadata.description: Tool registry integration for TR-808 style drum pattern sequencing and audio generation using ffmpeg to stitch samples into finished tracks
metadata.author: automated-developer

globalContext.audioEngine: ffmpeg for concatenation, mixing, and export
globalContext.patternFormat: Grid-based step sequencer (16 steps per bar typical)
globalContext.tr808Sounds: kick, snare, clap, hihat-closed, hihat-open, tom-low, tom-mid, tom-high, cymbal, cowbell, rimshot, conga-low, conga-mid, conga-high, maracas, claves

goals.objective: Initialize project with ffmpeg bindings and audio processing dependencies

success: Sample files downloaded and cached locally
acceptance: ffmpeg accessible via subprocess or binding

constraints: ffmpeg must be installed on system
Support both Python and Rust implementations

goals.objective: Define mapping between input identifiers and TR-808 drum sample files

success: Sample map: short code -> sample file path
Support multiple aliases per sound (kick, bd, bass_drum)
Velocity/variation support if multiple samples exist
Sample metadata: name, category, default_velocity, duration_ms

constraints: Use standard TR-808 abbreviations as primary keys

context.sampleMap: BD/kick: kick.mp3, SD/snare: snare.mp3, CH/hihat: hihat-closed.mp3, OH: hihat-open.mp3, CP/clap: clap.mp3, CB/cowbell: cowbell.mp3, CY/cymbal: cymbal.mp3, RS/rim: rimshot.mp3, LT: tom-low.mp3, MT: tom-mid.mp3, HT: tom-high.mp3, LC: conga-low.mp3, MC: conga-mid.mp3, HC: conga-high.mp3, MA/maracas: maracas.mp3, CL/claves: claves.mp3
context.categories: kicks, snares, hihats, toms, congas, percussion, cymbals

goals.objective: Implement parser for drum pattern notation converting string input to sequenced events

success: Parse JSON pattern format with timing info
acceptance: Multiple instruments in single pattern string

constraints: Support velocity levels: x=80, X=127, o=50

context.gridFormat: INSTRUMENT PATTERN where pattern is x/-/X/o characters

goals.objective: Implement timing calculation for converting pattern steps to audio timestamps

success: Calculate step duration from BPM and time signature
Generate precise timestamps for each hit

constraints: Default: 4/4 time, 4 steps per beat (16th notes)

goals.objective: Implement ffmpeg-based audio mixing engine to combine samples at specified timestamps

success: Mix multiple samples at precise timestamps
Generate intermediate silence for timing gaps

constraints: Use ffmpeg amix or amerge filters
Support sample rate conversion if needed

context.ffmpegApproach: Generate filter_complex with adelay for each sample, then amix all streams

goals.objective: Implement pattern rendering pipeline from parsed pattern to mixed audio file

success: Pipeline: parse -> timing -> ffmpeg mix -> output
Support loop count for pattern repetition

constraints: Temp files cleaned up after render

context.renderSteps: 1. Parse pattern -> 2. Calculate timestamps -> 3. Build ffmpeg filter graph -> 4. Execute ffmpeg -> 5. Return output path
context.loopMethod: Render one iteration, then ffmpeg concat for loops

goals.objective: Implement song builder for chaining multiple patterns into complete arrangements

success: Arrangement format: [A, A, B, A, B, B] pattern sequence
acceptance: Patterns stitch without gaps or clicks

constraints: All patterns must have same BPM for seamless join
Support pattern labels (intro, verse, chorus, etc.)

goals.objective: Implement library of preset drum patterns for common genres and styles

success: Preset patterns: basic_rock, four_on_floor, boom_bap, trap, dnb, etc.
list_presets() returns available presets with descriptions
acceptance: Easy to extend with custom presets

constraints: Store presets as JSON or embedded data

context.genres: rock, pop, hip-hop, trap, house, techno, drum-and-bass, reggae, funk, disco

goals.objective: Implement humanization to add timing and velocity variation for natural feel

success: Timing jitter: random offset within configurable range
Velocity variation: random adjustment to hit volumes

context.perInstrument: Snare often has more variation than kick

goals.objective: Define JSON schema for create_drum tool interface

success: Input schema: action, pattern, bpm, loops, output_format, output_path
Output schema: audio_path, duration_ms, bpm, pattern_bars
Action types: render, build_song, list_samples, list_presets, get_preset
acceptance: Schema validates with JSON Schema Draft-07

context.renderOptional: bpm (default 120), loops (default 1), swing (default 0), output_format (default wav), output_path, humanize (default false)

goals.objective: Implement tool registry handler for JSON request processing

success: render action generates audio from pattern
build_song action chains patterns into arrangement
acceptance: All actions return valid JSON per schema

constraints: Return audio path, not audio data

goals.objective: Create CLI for standalone drum pattern rendering
Write tests for pattern parsing, timing, and audio generation

success: Pattern parser tests for all notation formats
Integration tests with actual ffmpeg rendering

constraints: Mock ffmpeg for unit tests where possible
Verify output audio duration matches expected

context.timingTests: Verify step durations at various BPMs

goals.objective: Write documentation for pattern format, samples, and usage

acceptance: Pattern format clearly explained with examples

context.sections: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, Pattern Format, Samples, Presets, CLI Reference, API, Troubleshooting

goals.objective: Package create_drum tool for registration with tool registry

success: Health check verifies ffmpeg and samples available
acceptance: render action returns audio file path

constraints: ffmpeg must be available in environment
Bundle samples or download on first use

context.manifestDescription: TR-808 style drum pattern sequencer with ffmpeg audio rendering
